title: ImgBB Upload Response
description: JSON response schema returned by the ImgBB v1 upload API on success.

data.description: Image metadata returned on successful upload.

title.description: Image title (auto-generated or from the name parameter).

url_viewer.description: URL of the ImgBB viewer page for this image.

url.description: Direct URL to the full-size image.

width.description: Image width in pixels (returned as string).

height.description: Image height in pixels (returned as string).

size.description: File size in bytes (returned as string).

time.description: Unix timestamp of the upload (returned as string).

expiration.description: Expiration in seconds from upload time; "0" means no expiration (permanent).

medium.description: Metadata for the medium-sized image variant.

delete_url.description: URL to permanently delete this image from ImgBB.

success.description: True if the upload was successful.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored in the response body.

ImageVariant.description: Metadata for an image or image variant.
